technique_name: Describe the disadvantages of using commercial facial recognition software.
description: The use of commercial facial recognition software can lead to a number of potential disadvantages. Firstly, the software often has a high false-positive rate, meaning that it may mistakenly identify a person as someone else. This can lead to mistakes when it comes to identifying criminals or other suspicious individuals.
